The guide says the quick start uses `just infra-up`, `just migrate-up`, `just run-dev`. `run-dev` sets `APP_AUTH__ISSUER_URL=http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution`. For that to work on host, `auth.localhost` must resolve. On many systems `*.localhost` resolves to 127.0.0.1 automatically (glibc's NSS or systemd-resolved). But here it does NOT resolve, because /etc/nsswitch.conf uses files + dns, and there's no wildcard. So the installer should have added `auth.localhost` to /etc/hosts. This is an environment/installation deficiency.
